source_snapshot_caveat.explanation: A read_s-only instrumentation edit was briefly saved during an active screen then reverted without recompiling. These runs used the same binary as all other trials but captured that uncompiled source edit. Original manifests/snapshots retained; actual compiled source is the current hash. Physical routes, priorities and work counts are unaffected; read_s excludes donor parsing in the actual binary. Do not claim each affected snapshot alone rebuilds the exact recorded binary.
